description: Restore the compact Lorelum Installed Pack Catalog at supported WorkBuddy session boundaries.

hooks.command: if output="$(lore hook workbuddy)"; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; else printf '%s\n' '{"continue":true}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: try { $output = & lore hook workbuddy; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $output } else { '{"continue":true}' } } catch { '{"continue":true}' }
